name: hivepantry
description: HivePantry is a log of calories and macronutrients for AI agents. A Cloudflare Worker serves MCP and REST. D1 keeps the log.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply hivepantry-db --local --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your admin password. Use a minimum of 16 characters. You sign in to /console with it. You make agent tokens there. Keep it in a safe location.
